name: Red Cross
officialName: International Committee of the Red Cross
aliases: International Committee of the Red Cross

flag.description: A red cross with arms of equal length in the centre of a white field.
flag.symbolism: The emblem reverses the colours of Switzerland's flag in honour of the country where the movement was founded; it marks people and places protected in war.

hook: The Red Cross is Switzerland turned inside out: a red cross on white instead of Switzerland's white cross on a square red flag.
trivia: The ICRC was founded in Geneva after Henry Dunant saw the wounded left on the battlefield of Solferino in 1859.
The ICRC has won the Nobel Peace Prize three times, in 1917, 1944 and 1963.
